product_one_liner.value: BombBomb Engage lets relationship-driven sales teams create, send, and track personalized videos to strengthen relationships, improve engagement, and accelerate business outcomes.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Engage as a video messaging platform for teams and its mission as helping relationship-driven sales teams connect with customers.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists plans and pricing.

named_customers.notes: These organizations appear on BombBomb’s about page as customer references.

employee_band.notes: A company profile estimated approximately 71 employees in October 2026, which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: BombBomb’s company profile identifies Denver, Colorado, US as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile and company page state that BombBomb was founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: BombBomb’s Developer Blog has multiple engineering-authored technical posts, including infrastructure posts about CloudFront cache invalidation/cache busting.

public_docs.notes: BombBomb provides an API developer portal and a public support center with multiple product and API articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page says there are no open positions.

model_provider.notes: BombBomb’s public AI feature documentation and security/privacy FAQ describe AI functionality and controls but do not identify the underlying model or provider; no public subprocessor disclosure naming one was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names its SOC 2 Type 2 certification and says it complies with data-protection regulations including GDPR.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists a $2.43 million Series A deal dated March 12, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was in March 2025, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page says there are no open positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 2026 announcement describes a new BombBomb experience, including a new dashboard, video library, and notifications, with migration scheduled for November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kathryn Adamson’s profile lists her as BombBomb’s Vice President of Growth starting March 1, 2026, within the prior 12 months.
